resources.string: An Arch Linux ARM AArch64 environment for security work, on Android

ThothTerm Security runs an Arch Linux ARM AArch64 environment. It starts as a plain, minimal Arch Linux ARM system with no security tools installed. If you choose to, it can also enable the third-party BlackArch repository, after showing you what is downloaded; the app then offers the part of that catalog built for AArch64, which is smaller than the x86_64 catalog, and not every package installs. This app is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the BlackArch, Arch Linux or Arch Linux ARM projects. Arch Linux is a trademark of Levente Polyák and Judd Vinet, on behalf of Arch Linux.
The environment is a PRoot userland, not a booted system: pacman and ordinary programs work, while services that need systemd as PID 1 (systemctl) are not available. Use security tools only on systems you own or are authorised to test.
The environment needs to be downloaded

ThothTerm Security runs an Arch Linux ARM %1$s environment. This build does not include it, so it has to be downloaded before the terminal can start.

What you are agreeing to: • This downloads executable software onto your device after installation. • It consists of unmodified packages from the Arch Linux ARM repositories, each checked against Arch Linux ARM’s signing key when the ThothTerm project assembled them into a root filesystem, and published unchanged since. Arch Linux ARM did not build or endorse this download. • It is not part of this app’s package and was not built or verified by F‑Droid. • ThothTerm checks the download’s size and SHA‑256 checksum against values fixed in this app’s source, and refuses it if they do not match. A failed or interrupted download changes nothing and can be retried. • No third-party security repository is included. Enabling one is a separate, optional step in the menu, with its own consent screen. • LAN Mode stays off unless you turn it on. When it is on, terminal traffic and uploaded files are not encrypted in transit: use it only on networks you trust.
Nothing is downloaded unless you choose Download.
The environment was not downloaded. You can start the download whenever you want.
LAN Mode lets a computer on the same Wi-Fi network use this environment in a web browser. Each browser gets a terminal of its own; the windows on this phone are not shared.
